_description: Structured JSON lambda/llm_review.py asks Bedrock (Claude) to return. Rendered by lambda/notify.py into the CloudWatch custom widget and the SNS email.
explanation: Commit a1b2c3d removed the retry cap in bad_app.py's downstream call handling, allowing unbounded retries under load. This aligns with the latency spike observed starting at 14:32Z.

suggested_fix.summary: Re-add the retry cap / backoff limit removed in a1b2c3d.
suggested_fix.risk_note: This mitigation restores prior behavior but doesn't address why the retry cap was removed in the first place — confirm nothing else relies on the longer timeout before shipping.
